{"command": "python3 << 'EOF'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data
methods = ['GPT-4o', 'AutoEval', 'BrowserGym', 'BrowserGym axtree', 'AWM', 'Step']
success_rates = [14.9, 20.2, 23.5, 15.0, 35.5, 33.0]

# Colors - distinguish baseline, our method, and human baseline
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#96CEB4', '#FFEE66', '#9B59B6']

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create bar chart
bars = ax.bar(methods, success_rates, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)

# Add value labels on top of bars
for bar, rate in zip(bars, success_rates):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax.annotate(f'{rate}%',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 3),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Customize
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('WebArena Benchmark: Success Rate Comparison', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_ylim(0, 45)
ax.axhline(y=33.0, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Human Baseline (Step)')

# Add legend
ax.legend(loc='upper left')

# Improve layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('webarena_benchmark.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print("Figure saved successfully!")
EOF"}

{"command": "python3 << 'EOF'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data - sorted by success rate (highest to lowest)
data = [
    ('AWM', 35.5, 'our'),
    ('Step', 33.0, 'human'),
    ('BrowserGym', 23.5, 'baseline'),
    ('AutoEval', 20.2, 'baseline'),
    ('GPT-4o', 14.9, 'baseline'),
    ('BrowserGym axtree', 15.0, 'baseline')
]

# Sort by success rate descending
data_sorted = sorted(data, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

methods = [d[0] for d in data_sorted]
success_rates = [d[1] for d in data_sorted]
categories = [d[2] for d in data_sorted]

# Colors - baseline in light gray, our method and human baseline in distinct colors
colors = []
for cat in categories:
    if cat == 'baseline':
        colors.append('#D3D3D3')  # light gray
    elif cat == 'our':
        colors.append('#FFEE66')  # yellow for AWM
    else:  # human
        colors.append('#9B59B6')  # purple for Step

# Create figure without border
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6), facecolor='white')

# Create bar chart without edge color (no borders)
bars = ax.bar(methods, success_rates, color=colors, edgecolor='none')

# Add value labels on top of bars
for bar, rate in zip(bars, success_rates):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax.annotate(f'{rate}%',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 3),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Customize
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('WebArena Benchmark: Success Rate Comparison', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_ylim(0, 45)

# Add legend
legend_labels = ['Baseline Methods', 'Our Method (AWM)', 'Human Baseline (Step)']
legend_colors = ['#D3D3D3', '#FFEE66', '#9B59B6']
for label, color in zip(legend_labels, legend_colors):
    ax.bar([], [], color=color, label=label)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False)

# Remove top and right spines for cleaner look
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Improve layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure without border
plt.savefig('webarena_benchmark.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
print("Figure saved successfully!")
EOF"}

{"command": "python3 << 'EOF'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

# Data - sorted by success rate (highest to lowest)
data = [
    ('AWM', 35.5, 'our'),
    ('Step', 33.0, 'human'),
    ('BrowserGym', 23.5, 'baseline'),
    ('AutoEval', 20.2, 'baseline'),
    ('GPT-4o', 14.9, 'baseline'),
    ('BrowserGym axtree', 15.0, 'baseline')
]

# Sort by success rate descending
data_sorted = sorted(data, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

methods = [d[0] for d in data_sorted]
success_rates = [d[1] for d in data_sorted]
categories = [d[2] for d in data_sorted]

# Colors - baseline in light gray, our method and human baseline in distinct colors
colors = []
for cat in categories:
    if cat == 'baseline':
        colors.append('#D3D3D3')  # light gray
    elif cat == 'our':
        colors.append('#FFEE66')  # yellow for AWM
    else:  # human
        colors.append('#9B59B6')  # purple for Step

# Create figure without border
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6), facecolor='white')

# Create bar chart without edge color (no borders)
bars = ax.bar(methods, success_rates, color=colors, edgecolor='none')

# Add value labels on top of bars
for bar, rate in zip(bars, success_rates):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax.annotate(f'{rate}%',
                xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                xytext=(0, 3),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Customize
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('WebArena Benchmark: Success Rate Comparison', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_ylim(0, 40)  # Adjusted to accommodate bars up to 35.5

# Set y-axis ticks every 10 units, highest at 30
ax.set_yticks([0, 10, 20, 30])

# Add legend using Patch objects for correct colors
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#D3D3D3', edgecolor='none', label='Baseline Methods'),
    Patch(facecolor='#FFEE66', edgecolor='none', label='Our Method (AWM)'),
    Patch(facecolor='#9B59B6', edgecolor='none', label='Human Baseline (Step)')
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', frameon=False)

# Remove top and right spines for cleaner look
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Improve layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure without border
plt.savefig('webarena_benchmark.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
print("Figure saved successfully!")
EOF"}
